games.name: Area 47: Roleplay
games.desc:
SCP - Area 47: Roleplay Welcome to Armed SCP Containment Area 47, a Role-Playing game for all things SCP!

This game is based on the SCP genre, and is a facility containing the most dangerous SCPs. The SCP Foundation is a multi-government collaboration to protect humanity. Contained in the facility are SCP Creatures of horror, SCP Monsters that could destroy the world if they ever escape. 

In this SCP Site Roleplay, you can play as all kinds of roles like Class - D, Scientist, Mobile Task Force, Security Department, and many more! Through playing these various roles, level up your keycard clearance in the Foundation, and assist in creating the most secure SCP Facility to exist.

Want to learn more about the Foundation, and get some special in-game perks? Join our group! https://www.roblox.com/groups/2760782/SCPF

Game Rules: https://devforum.roblox.com/t/3551820

games.name: Siren Head : The Forest
games.desc:
🌲 Welcome to "Siren Head : The Forest", a horror game set in a mysterious and haunted 🌲 forest. Players will need to navigate through the dense, dark woods while avoiding various monsters that roam the forest at night.
───── ⋆⋅☆⋅⋆ ─────
Some of the monsters you'll encounter include the Bridge Worm, Siren Head, Cartoon Cat, Cartoon Dog, Costume Man, Face Man, Choo Choo Charles, and Bones Worth, Doors, etc. Each of these creatures is unique and poses its own set of challenges for players to overcome.
───── ⋆⋅☆⋅⋆ ─────
💪 To help you survive, join the game's group to get 10% more health. For even more benefits, consider becoming a premium member. As a premium member, you'll receive buffs such as more health and a higher jump, giving you an edge in your fight against the forest's fearsome monsters.
───── ⋆⋅☆⋅⋆ ─────
